'''Elio Bonton''' was a high-class [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who made a living separating young [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] nobles from their money. The young nobles found him very entertaining and he always had an interesting tale or amusing story to tell. Older nobles didn't like Elio although they could not dissuade their children from interacting with him.<ref name="LOTE" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Bonton was a handsome man in his early thirties who dressed well and was said to carry himself like a [[warrior]]. Several [[Tapani Noble Houses|House]] intelligence agencies tried to recruit him but he was not interested.<ref name="LOTE" />
